{{Top|leg}}
'''Beamcleaners''' were cleaning tools<ref name="TTDJ">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref> that utilized [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> to scour huge surfaces of debris and litter.<ref name="TTDJ" /> Fourteen beamcleaners were installed on [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="TTDJ" /> where they worked in tandem with large [[scrubber brush]]es,<ref name="EGTD" /> and [[IC-M General Utility Droid]]s had a laser beamcleaner equipped on one of its arms.<ref name="EGTD" />
